Mathematical_Definition: |M_gr(t) - M_gr(0) - Int_0^t (SMB - Q_GL) dt + M_unground| / M_gr(0)
Analytical_Justification: Telescopic internal face flux cancellation is algebraically guaranteed on fixed grids; however moving grounding-line subgrid interpolation introduces O(dx) or O(dx^2) repartitioning errors
Whole_Model_Conservation_Caveat: Machine precision (~1e-14) on internal cells does NOT guarantee 1e-7 whole-model conservation when moving boundary interpolation is coupled
Required_Benchmark_Test_Suite: Expanded MGL-01 Test Suite (Sub-tests A through E across 100 yr)
Phase_5_2_2_Governance_Action: Adopted as Empirically Testable Target; benchmarked in Stage 1 before production runs

Mathematical_Definition: |V_{dt}(t) - V_{dt_ref}(t)| / V_{dt_ref}(t) between dt=0.05 yr and dt=0.005 yr at t=50 yr
Analytical_Justification: First-order forward/semi-implicit time stepping has truncation error O(dt); stiff power-law rheology (n=3) and rapid ungrounding cause discrete phase shifts in cell-crossing timing
Whole_Model_Conservation_Caveat: A 0.5% difference in 50-year volume can reflect a 2-month phase shift in grounding line retreat rather than numerical divergence
Required_Benchmark_Test_Suite: Richardson extrapolation on 3 timesteps (dt=0.05 0.025 0.0125 yr) in Test 11
Phase_5_2_2_Governance_Action: Adopted as Provisional Engineering Threshold; verified via order-of-accuracy convergence

Mathematical_Definition: |q_GL(t^+) - q_GL(t^-)| / q_GL(t^-) across cell boundary crossing
Analytical_Justification: Subgrid flotation root-finding yields continuous x_GL but piecewise regularized basal friction across cell nodes creates weak slope discontinuities in velocity gradient
Whole_Model_Conservation_Caveat: Zero flux jump is impossible on discrete grids; 1% is an empirical limit to prevent shock-induced Picard divergence
Required_Benchmark_Test_Suite: High-frequency (100 Hz equivalent) discharge sampling during Sub-test MGL-01-E
Phase_5_2_2_Governance_Action: Adopted as Provisional Engineering Threshold; monitor flux continuity during ungrounding
